answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable 500 POA stake for 90 days before its work counts, with the stake slashed if peers prove fraud. Like an ocean crossed only by a single toll bridge, every identity pays the same crossing cost: forging 1,000 fake agents would lock 500,000 POA for three months, while honest agents earn it back. A shale layer of on-chain reputation, 30 peer-attested jobs before full weight, makes the fake fleet useless until it does real work.
